analysis.summary:
ISSUES
Critical:
- The "How It Works" page failed the web performance test. Investigate the cause of the failure and optimize the page to improve its load time.
insights: The homepage has the longest load time (638 ms) among the passed tests, suggesting room for optimization. Investigate potential bottlenecks, such as large media files, excessive HTTP requests, or render-blocking resources.
The blog page has the shortest TTFB (Time to First Byte) (77 ms), indicating efficient server response times. Use this as a benchmark for other pages to improve server performance.

The pricing page has a higher FCP (249 ms) than the blog page, suggesting that the initial content rendering could be optimized. Analyze the critical rendering path and optimize the delivery of above-the-fold content.
